repository.description: Full repository; overrides global.imageRegistry and name.

tag.description: Image tag; empty: global.imageTag, then the chart's appVersion.

resources.description: CPU and memory requests and limits.

global.description: Shared with the other charts of an umbrella chart: keys of theirs are allowed, Paguro's own are validated.

imageRegistry.description: Registry prefix of the three images: <registry>/<name>:<tag>. The published chart pulls from ghcr.io/dpicillo/paguro; set a mirror (ECR, Harbor) here.

imageTag.description: Tag of all three images; empty: the chart's appVersion.

imagePullSecrets.description: Pull secrets for a private registry or mirror, as a list of {name: <secret>}.

controller.description: The controller: preflight, target selection, the pod and eviction webhooks, the Migration status.

migrationsPerNode.description: Migrations that move pods off one node at a time; further ones wait in phase Pending while their pods run on. 0: no bound.

evictionTargetWait.description: How long a migration started by an eviction waits for a node to move to – Karpenter launches one while it drains a node (Go duration; 0: no wait). Then the eviction goes through as without Paguro.

replicas.description: Controller replicas. Every replica serves the webhooks and the leader runs the migrations; two keep the webhooks reachable while one restarts (helm upgrade). 1 is fine for tests.

leaderElect.description: Leader election between the replicas; must stay true with more than one.

logLevel.description: Log level: debug, info, error or a verbosity number.

extraArgs.description: Additional command-line arguments of the controller.

resources.description: Requests and limits of the controller.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector of the controller pods.

tolerations.description: Tolerations of the controller pods; by default they may run on control-plane nodes.

priorityClassName.description: Priority class of the controller pods.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations of the controller pods; prometheus.io/port follows ports.metrics unless set here.

webhook.description: Port of the admission webhooks (pods, evictions).

probes.description: Port of the liveness and readiness probes.

agent.description: The agent DaemonSet: checkpoints, transfers and restores pods on its node.

onlyLabelledNodes.description: Run the agent and the node installer only on nodes labelled paguro.dev/enabled=true; pods migrate only between such nodes.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector of the agent DaemonSet.

tolerations.description: Tolerations of the agent DaemonSet. The agent must run on every node a migratable pod may run on, tainted nodes included.

priorityClassName.description: Priority class of the agent pods.

ports.description: Ports of the agent on the host network.

transfer.description: Port of the agent-to-agent transfer (host network).

metrics.description: Port of the agent's Prometheus metrics (host network).

health.description: Port of the agent's health probes (host network).

resources.description: Requests and limits of the agent. The CPU request is the agent's and CRIU's weight on a busy node, and so the pre-copy's speed there. No memory limit by default: it would evict received checkpoints from the page cache and slow the restore.

updateStrategy.description: Update strategy of the agent DaemonSet.

drainTimeoutSeconds.description: On SIGTERM (upgrade, uninstall), how long the agent lets the migrations on its node finish; its terminationGracePeriodSeconds is 15 s longer.

extraArgs.description: Additional command-line arguments of the agent.

stateDir.description: Host directory where checkpoints are staged; mounted at the same path, because paguro-runc reads them outside the pod.

runDir.description: Host directory for the runtime files of the agent and paguro-runc.

token.description: Shared token of the agent-to-agent transfer.

existingSecret.description: Secret with the agents' shared token (key "token"); empty: generated once and kept across upgrades.

kubeletDir.description: kubelet's data directory on the nodes (some distributions move it).

testFaults.description: Failure tests only: honour the paguro.dev/test-fault annotation, which makes a migration fail at a named point. Never in production.

enabled.description: Mutual TLS for the agent-to-agent transfer, with a certificate per node that the controller signs only for that node. Disable only on an isolated network; agents with and without TLS do not migrate between each other.

Attach RWO volumes to the target node during pre-copy, so that the attach leaves the freeze (multi-attach volume types only, e.g. EBS io2, Cinder multiattach). Grants the agents create and delete on VolumeAttachments.
ValidatingAdmissionPolicy that holds every agent to its own node: its Node, its migrations, its VolumeAttachments (Kubernetes 1.30 or later; skipped before).

nodeInstaller.description: The node installer (init container of the agent): prepares each node and reports what is missing.

enabled.description: Prepare every node before the agent starts: CRIU, nftables, crictl, paguro-runc and the containerd runtime handler. false if the nodes are prepared otherwise (Ansible, image build).

restartContainerd.description: Restart containerd when the runtime handler had to be added; running containers survive. false: the installer stops with a message instead.

criuMinVersion.description: Oldest host CRIU accepted; with an older one, or none, the bundled CRIU is used.

requirePrecopy.description: Fail on nodes without soft-dirty tracking instead of warning (there, without pre-copy, all memory is copied during the freeze).

containerd.description: Where containerd is; empty fields are detected from the running containerd.

binary.description: Path of the containerd binary; empty: detected from the running process.

configPath.description: Path of containerd's config.toml; empty: from the process's --config argument.

unit.description: systemd unit of containerd; empty: detected from its cgroup.

dropInDir.description: Drop-in directory used when config.toml has no imports glob yet; empty: <config dir>/conf.d.

resources.description: Requests and limits of the node installer.

create.description: Create the RuntimeClass; skipped if one with this name exists that this release did not create.

name.description: Name of the RuntimeClass that migratable pods get.

handler.description: containerd runtime handler of the RuntimeClass, configured by the node installer.

webhook.description: The admission webhooks for pods and evictions.

failurePolicy.description: Failure policy of the pod webhook. Ignore: an unreachable controller never blocks pod creation; pods created meanwhile are reported as NotMutated.

timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout of the webhook calls in seconds.

excludeNamespaces.description: Namespaces the webhooks never see; the release namespace is always added.

extraNamespaceSelector.description: Additional matchExpressions for the webhooks' namespaceSelector, e.g. to opt namespaces in by label.

evictions.description: Turn evictions of migratable pods into migrations: kubectl drain, Karpenter, the Cluster Autoscaler and node group upgrades then move such pods instead of restarting them.

adapter.description: CNI adapter: auto (detected by the controller from the CNI's CRDs), cilium, calico or generic. The chart renders the Cilium socket mount for auto and cilium.

stickyCIDR.description: IPv4 range for the kept /32 addresses of migratable pods on Cilium (multi-pool IPAM); must not overlap the pod, node or VPC ranges.

ciliumSocketDir.description: Directory of the Cilium agent's API socket on the host.

cpuBaseline.description: CPU features migratable pods may use, so that they can move between CPU generations: auto (shared by all nodes with an agent), x86-64-v1 to x86-64-v4 (a fixed level, for node types that change) or off (no baseline).

phantom.description: Phantom mode: new pod IP, in-cluster connections kept by eBPF translation (docs/PHANTOM-MODE.md).

enabled.description: Load the Phantom-mode translator. Network mode Auto falls back to Phantom mode, instead of closing connections, when every node supports it.

clusterCIDRs.description: Extra prefixes that belong to the cluster, if the CNI does not publish its pod ranges (node podCIDRs, Cilium and Calico pools and Service CIDRs are detected).

steeringMark.description: Bit of the packet mark that routes forwarded migrated connections (pods behind a ClusterIP, NodePort clients) to the new address, as hex. The default is outside the bits of kube-proxy, Cilium, Calico and the AWS VPC CNI.

install.description: Install and upgrade the Migration CRD with the chart (kept on uninstall).

commitGate.description: Commit gate (DRA driver): replacements wait right before their sandbox

enabled.description: Commit gate, a DRA driver in the agent: a replacement that keeps the IP gets its sandbox the moment the migration commits, about 0.6 s less freeze (Kubernetes 1.34 or later).

earlyHandOver.description: Cilium: create the replacement's sandbox while the final dump runs, about 0.15 s less freeze; a rollback gives the address back to the source.

monitoring.description: Prometheus Operator objects and the Grafana dashboard.

enabled.description: Alert rules as a PrometheusRule. auto: when the Prometheus Operator's API exists at install time.

labels.description: Labels of the PrometheusRule, e.g. release: kube-prometheus-stack for the operator's ruleSelector.

enabled.description: PodMonitors for the controller and the agents. auto: when the Prometheus Operator's API exists at install time.

labels.description: Labels of the PodMonitors, for the operator's podMonitorSelector.

enabled.description: The Grafana dashboard as a ConfigMap for Grafana's dashboard sidecar.

namespace.description: Namespace of the dashboard ConfigMap; empty: the release namespace.

labels.description: Labels of the dashboard ConfigMap, for the sidecar's label selector.

agones.description: Agones game servers move with their GameServer

enabled.description: Agones integration: GameServers move with their game state and stay Allocated. auto: when the GameServer API exists at install time (Kubernetes 1.30 or later).
